description.zh: 通知渠道（JSON数组字符串），如 ["sms","email"]
description.en: The notification channels in a JSON array string, such as ["sms","email"].

description.zh: 邮件通知字段（JSON数组字符串），最多10个
description.en: The email notification fields in a JSON array string. A maximum of 10 fields are supported.

description.en: The list of email recipient IDs in a JSON array string.

description.zh: 短信接收人ID列表（JSON数组字符串）
description.en: The list of SMS recipient IDs in a JSON array string.

description.zh: 短信通知字段（JSON数组字符串），最多3个
description.en: The SMS notification fields in a JSON array string. A maximum of 3 fields are supported.

description.zh: 短信发送限制（JSON字符串），包含 minInterval、dailyLimit 字段
description.en: The SMS sending limit in a JSON string, including the minInterval and dailyLimit fields.
